description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git reflog display routines. It contains test cases that verify the output of various Git log and reflog commands, including formatting, date options, and reflog expiration.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs, asserting they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that the given output is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock, used in timestamp-related tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
